Convert Varo Messages To EMS.description: Converts Varo and FridgeTag files pulled from email into EMS-compliant cold-chain reports.

Convert Records To EMS Report.description: Groups flat EMS-like fridge readings into reports, one per device, with a records array.

Convert RTMD Records To Reports.description: Converts remote temperature monitoring device (RTMD) records into EMS reports.

Build Varo Message Contents.description: Turns EMS reports into email-ready message parts (subject, body, data.json) for a Varo inbox.

Get UTC Range For Local Dates.description: Works out the UTC window and collection key patterns for a local date range in a facility's time zone.

Filter Keys In Date Range.description: Keeps only the keys whose embedded timestamp falls within a UTC range.
